plain_text:
Gale Gordon appears in 373 recordings across 12 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1933 to 1953. The credits here include performer, narrator, host, and announcer.

In this archive, you will hear Gale Gordon most often in Fibber McGee and Molly, Fu Manchu, My Favorite Husband, The Phil Harris-Alice Faye Show, The Great Gildersleeve, Calling All Cars, Lux Radio Theatre, and Dr. Christian.

Characters credited here include Dr. James Petrie, Rudolph Atterbury, Mayor LaTrivia, and Dr. William Todhunter Hall.
